note: Advertising-claim wording checks (F79, T99): the words the workspace only notices, never blocks. verified is true only when basis cites the provision's own text; every other entry marks common enforcement practice and still has to be checked against the official rules before relying on it. Administrators can replace this whole file with Data/EcomCraft/claim-words.json in the same format (the same mechanism as platforms.json); a damaged override falls back to this built-in file. This list was written offline on 2026-11-03 without a legal review: no entry is legal advice, and none of it was checked against an official source online.
